# Na medicínu

> Interaktivní lekce biologie v češtině pro přípravu na přijímací zkoušky na lékařské fakulty. Každá lekce je prostorový model, který si student otočí, rozebere na očíslované části a projde ve čtyřech krocích (Prohlížej, Najdi, Pojmenuj, Seřaď), volitelně s mluveným výkladem. Veřejné lekce jsou zdarma, bez reklam a bez účtu; přihlášení e-mailem (bez hesla) jen přenáší postup mezi zařízeními.
>
> Interactive biology lessons in Czech for medical-school entrance exam prep. Each lesson is a 3D model the learner turns, opens part by part and works through in four steps, with optional narration. Public lessons are free, ad-free and need no account; signing in by e-mail (no password) only syncs progress between devices.

## What it is
- A web app in Czech (gymnázium level) with biology lessons for Czech medical-school entrance exams, in the order of a school workbook's chapters.
- Lessons are added over time; the sitemap lists every public lesson page.
- Progress is kept in the browser; with sign-in it syncs to the cloud.
- Some newer lessons are shown only to invited members until a person has read them; they are not listed here.

## How to use it
- Course home with all lessons in workbook order: https://medicina.dravec.org/
- A lesson, e.g. cell cycle and cell division: https://medicina.dravec.org/deleni-bunky/

## Data & provenance
- Lesson text follows a Czech school biology workbook (terms, number of phases); where a university textbook differs, that is mentioned in the deeper level.
- The cell-division lesson was checked by two independent reviews against standard sources (corrections applied 2026-11-10). It is study material, not medical advice.
